<thought>Provide the requested five‑step retrosynthetic route in the specified JSON format. The route proceeds from the target molecule back to simple precursors using the following transformations (each represented by a placeholder template ID): 1) TBS deprotection, 2) TBS protection, 3) Still‑Gennari Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (Z‑selective), 4) DIBAL‑H reduction of an ester to an aldehyde, and 5) standard (E‑selective) Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons coupling. The JSON tree lists each reaction with its precursor(s) and a simple reagent SMILES for clarity.</thought>
